title: Measures to Prevent Abuse of Foreign Domestic Workers
what_it_is: Measures to Prevent Abuse of Foreign Domestic Workers

sections.label: MOM approach protecting foreign domestic workers
sections.summary: MOM adopts a three-pronged approach to protect foreign domestic workers against abuses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) adopts a three-pronged approach to protect foreign domestic workers against abuses.

sections.label: Penal Code punishment for abuse
sections.summary: The Penal Code was enhanced in 2020 to double punishment against individuals who abuse vulnerable victims, including foreign domestic workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Third, as a strong deterrent, the Penal Code was enhanced in 2020 to double the punishment against individuals who abuse vulnerable victims, including foreign domestic workers.

sections.label: MOM reviewing measures in three areas
sections.summary: MOM is reviewing measures in three areas to strengthen support for foreign domestic workers and reduce abuse.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To strengthen support for foreign domestic workers and reduce the incidence of abuse, MOM is reviewing measures in three areas.

sections.label: Detecting and reporting suspected abuse
sections.summary: MOM is working with the medical fraternity to make it more objective for doctors to detect and report suspected abuse cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Lastly, for an abused domestic worker who has no phone or day off, how would they be able to report abuse?

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We are working with the medical fraternity to look at how to make it more objective for the doctors to detect and to report suspected cases of abuse.

sections.label: Screening employers of foreign domestic workers
sections.summary: MOM takes note of employers of foreign domestic workers where past complaints were lodged against them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The second point about screening of employers, we do take note of employers of foreign domestic workers where past complaints were lodged against them.

sections.label: Investigating officers look into facts
sections.summary: MOM has its investigating officers look into the facts of the case.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: What MOM does is really, we will have our investigating officers to look into the facts of the case.

sections.label: Employment agency check-ins for workers
sections.summary: Some employment agencies voluntarily check on foreign domestic workers' well-being, and the government sees scope to institutionalise this practice and pursue mental health support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Currently, for employment agencies, although it is not mandated for them to check in on the foreign domestic workers, we do know of some employment agencies that take the extra step in checking with the employers as well as the foreign domestic workers on the state of well-being, whether they are getting along well and whether there are adjustment issues.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We think this is a good practice and there is scope for us look at institutionalising it, so that there is one more touchpoint for foreign domestic workers to raise concerns if they do encounter problems in the first few months of their employment, especially for those who are working in Singapore for the first time.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As to checking on the mental health and providing counselling or support, I think this is certainly an area that we will be interested to pursue.
